title: Sa'yo Lang Titibok
caption: Contemporary Filipino R&B and soul-pop love song sung in Tagalog. A smooth, breathy young male tenor, intimate and close to the microphone, gliding into a silky falsetto in the chorus, with stacked airy vocal harmonies and soft ad-libs. Mellow Rhodes electric piano chords, warm sub bass, a gentle clean electric guitar, slow laid-back R&B drums with finger snaps and crisp hi-hats, dreamy reverb. Tender, romantic, late at night, devoted to one girl. Modern, polished, warm production.
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse 1]
Hindi ko alam kung paano nagsimula
Isang tingin mo lang, ako'y natulala
Ang ngiti mong kay tamis, 'di ko malimutan
Sa bawat gabi, ikaw ang laman ng isipan

[Pre-Chorus]
Dahan-dahan, lumalapit ang puso ko
'Di na kayang itago pa ito

[Chorus]
Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang ako
Wala nang iba, ikaw lang ang gusto
Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang, mahal

Sa'yo lang, sa'yo lang ako
Kahit saan, kahit kailan, pangako

Ang puso kong ito

[Bridge]

[Chorus]
